cfy.stdout:
A fast, memory-efficient Shopify CLI alternative

Usage: cfy [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  help          Display help for Catify
  commands      List all public Catify commands
  app           Manage Shopify apps
  theme         Manage Shopify themes
  completion    Generate a shell completion script on standard output
  version       Print build and runtime version information
  upgrade       Upgrade Catify through a supported installation channel
  auth          Authentication operations
  config        Catify configuration options
  notification  Show or clear Catify notification state
  cache         Manage local caches
  doctor        Diagnose the local Catify environment and project
  doc           Search and fetch Shopify documentation
  hydrogen      Build Hydrogen storefronts
  organization  List Shopify organizations
  store         Work directly with Shopify stores
  plugins       Manage CLI plugins
  search        Search Shopify developer documentation

Options:
      --verbose...       Increase diagnostic output; repeat for more detail
      --no-color         Disable ANSI color output
      --json             Emit machine-readable JSON when supported by the command
      --non-interactive  Never prompt for interactive input
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version

shopify.stdout:
A CLI tool to build for the Shopify platform

VERSION
  <version> darwin-arm64 node-v25.2.1

USAGE
  $ shopify [COMMAND]

TOPICS
  app           Build Shopify apps.
  auth          Auth operations.
  config        CLI configuration options.
  doc           Search and fetch documentation from shopify.dev.
  hydrogen      Build Hydrogen storefronts.
  organization  List Shopify organizations you have access to.
  store         Work directly with Shopify stores.
  theme         Build Liquid themes.
  upgrade       Upgrades Shopify CLI.

COMMANDS
  commands  List all shopify commands.
  help      Display help for Shopify CLI
  search    Search shopify.dev for the most relevant content matching a query.
            Best for discovery — surfacing the relevant pieces of documentation
            for a topic, rather than retrieving a whole document. To download a
            full document verbatim, use `doc fetch`.
  upgrade   Upgrades Shopify CLI.
  version   Shopify CLI version currently installed.

shopify.stdout:
Build Liquid themes.

USAGE
  $ shopify theme COMMAND

TOPICS
  theme metafields  Download metafields definitions from your shop into a local
                    file.

COMMANDS
  theme check            Validate the theme.
  theme console          Shopify Liquid REPL (read-eval-print loop) tool
  theme delete           Delete remote themes from the connected store. This
                         command can't be undone.
  theme dev              Uploads the current theme as a development theme to the
                         connected store, then prints theme editor and preview
                         URLs to your terminal. While running, changes will push
                         to the store in real time.
  theme duplicate        Duplicates a theme from your theme library.
  theme info             Displays information about your theme environment,
                         including your current store. Can also retrieve
                         information about a specific theme.
  theme init             Clones a Git repository to use as a starting point for
                         building a new theme.
  theme language-server  Start a Language Server Protocol server.
  theme list             Lists the themes in your store, along with their IDs
                         and statuses.
  theme open             Opens the preview of your remote theme.
  theme package          Package your theme into a .zip file, ready to upload to
                         the Online Store.
  theme preview          Applies JSON overrides to a theme and returns a preview
                         URL.
  theme profile          Profile the Liquid rendering of a theme page.
  theme publish          Set a remote theme as the live theme.
  theme pull             Download your remote theme files locally.
  theme push             Uploads your local theme files to the connected store,
                         overwriting the remote version if specified.
  theme rename           Renames an existing theme.
  theme share            Creates a shareable, unpublished, and new theme on your
                         theme library with a randomized name.

                designated address.

  app import-extensions               Import dashboard-managed extensions into

  app info                            Print basic information about your app and
                                      extensions.

  app logs                            Stream detailed logs for your Shopify app.
